Name: Slimey Henchman
Components: V, S, M (a vial of pink slime)
Description: You create an adorable, brainless Small ooze that carries and deploys items at your command until the spell ends. The ooze springs out of a puddle you summon in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. It has AC 12, 40 hit points, and a Strength of 8, and it can’t attack. If it drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends and it drops all its contents on the space it was standing. Once on each of your turns as a bonus action, you can mentally command the servant to move up to 15 feet and either give another creature an item stored inside it or put down a Deployable Tool. The servant may be linked to a container such as a chest, satchel or Bag of Holding during the casting of this spell, being able to teleport any contents of that container into its body if able or transporting any item in its body back to the container. If linked to a container, all items contained inside it are teleported back into the container when the spell ends or when it dies. If you link the ooze to another container while it is already linked, it forgets its previous connections and cannot access that container until linked again. If you command the ooze to move more than 60 feet away from you, the spell ends.
